title: Coven reliability, recovery, and usefulness scorecard
purpose: Current decision view for issue #807. Values remain unmeasured unless retained outcome evidence exists.

rows.definition: A supported packaged install verifies its binary and reaches an actionable doctor or health result.
rows.numerator: Qualifying installs that verify and reach actionable readiness.
rows.denominator: All qualifying install attempts in the cohort.
rows.cohort: Supported release and platform install channels.
rows.source: scripts/user-journey-e2e.mjs and setup --verify-only reports; #779 must retain the release/platform receipt.
rows.privacy: Version, platform, stage, duration, and normalized exit class only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; current hermetic journey coverage is binary fixture evidence, not a shipped cohort.
rows.action: Keep unmeasured until #779 retains per-platform installed-artifact outcomes.

rows.definition: A ready install starts a project-scoped session, accepts first input, and emits first output.
rows.cohort: Supported packaged installs using supported harnesses.
rows.privacy: Stage names, durations, harness id, platform, commit, and exit class; no prompt or output content.
rows.confidence: Not measured; deterministic fake-harness coverage cannot establish field success or latency.
rows.action: Add stage receipts to installed-artifact certification before publishing a baseline.

rows.metric: Inspect, control, reconnect, and restart recovery
rows.definition: A live session can be inspected, controlled, reattached, and recovered after a supported daemon restart.
rows.numerator: Journeys completing every required inspect, input, kill, terminal, reconnect, and restart stage.
rows.denominator: Journeys entering the control and recovery stage.
rows.window: No retained installed-artifact recovery cohort yet.
rows.source: user journey, daemon lifecycle, handoff/cursor, and orphan-recovery acceptance families.
rows.privacy: Opaque synthetic session ids and normalized outcomes only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; lower-level acceptance exists without one retained end-to-end receipt.
rows.action: Keep unmeasured until #779 records stage-level recovery outcomes.

rows.definition: Launch and input attempts resolve to success, explicit refusal, capability mismatch, or normalized failure without silent ambiguity.
rows.numerator: Attempts in each normalized outcome class.
rows.denominator: All qualifying launch or input attempts.
rows.cohort: Supported API clients and harnesses by release/platform.
rows.source: Daemon API contract tests and future privacy-preserving operation receipts.
rows.privacy: Operation kind, capability/version, stage, and normalized error only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; contract coverage proves behavior classes, not observed rates.
rows.action: Define a retained release-study cohort before adopting rates or thresholds.

rows.definition: Attach and reconnect attempts distinguish success, stale endpoint, peer replacement, and explicit recovery-required outcomes.
rows.numerator: Attempts in each attach or peer outcome class.
rows.denominator: All qualifying attach or reconnect attempts.
rows.cohort: Bundled clients against the supported local API.
rows.source: coven-client health negotiation and transport tests.
rows.privacy: Transport class and opaque peer fingerprint result only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; deterministic negotiation tests do not establish incidence.
rows.action: Populate from #779 client/platform receipts without retaining endpoint paths.

rows.metric: Ordered event consumption and cursor recovery
rows.definition: Consumers retain event order and recover cursors without silently skipping required events.
rows.numerator: Qualifying cursor journeys preserving order and recovery.
rows.source: Event cursor, handoff, and API contract acceptance tests.
rows.privacy: Sequence numbers and normalized recovery outcomes only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; acceptance coverage is not an observed shipped rate.
rows.action: Add a cursor stage to the installed-artifact receipt before publishing a baseline.

rows.metric: Kill, cancel, terminal, and explicit-unknown resolution
rows.definition: Control attempts resolve to a named terminal or recovery-required state; unknown is never counted as success.
rows.numerator: Attempts in each terminal, refusal, failure, or explicit-unknown class.
rows.denominator: All qualifying kill, cancel, and terminal-resolution attempts.
rows.source: Daemon lifecycle, PTY, cancellation, and session-state acceptance tests.
rows.privacy: Terminal class, duration, and normalized error only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; tests prove state semantics without incidence.
rows.action: Preserve unknown as its own class when a release receipt is introduced.

rows.metric: Output loss, cleanup, and crash recovery
rows.definition: Output truncation, backpressure, drop, orphan, cleanup, crash, and restart outcomes are classified with recoverability.
rows.numerator: Incidents in each loss, cleanup, orphan, and recovery class.
rows.denominator: Qualifying sessions or injected recovery trials.
rows.cohort: Supported release/platform combinations and declared deterministic trials.
rows.source: Output-marker, orphan-recovery, daemon lifecycle, and chaos acceptance families.
rows.privacy: Counts, byte totals, state classes, and recovery result; no output content.
rows.confidence: Not measured; deterministic failure injection is supporting evidence only.
rows.action: Keep fixture outcomes separate from shipped incidence in future receipts.

rows.definition: Every published version is bound to one accepted source commit with every required check successful for that exact commit.
rows.numerator: Published versions with a retained exact-commit governance receipt.
rows.denominator: All published versions in the window.
rows.privacy: Commit, tag, check names/conclusions, signer result, and artifact digests only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; #805 is open and no qualifying receipt exists.
rows.action: Do not claim compliance until #805 retains the immutable receipt.

rows.definition: Release, tag, registries, installers, checksums, provenance, notes, and support state identify the same public version.
rows.numerator: Published versions with coherent channel evidence.
rows.denominator: All published versions in the window.
rows.privacy: Public version and artifact metadata only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; current release metadata is not retained as one decision receipt.
rows.action: Keep unmeasured until one receipt covers every supported channel.

rows.definition: Published artifacts pass the named user journey on each supported release/platform/install channel.
rows.denominator: Required cells in the support matrix.
rows.cohort: Published artifacts for the current supported release family.
rows.window: Begins when #779 retains its matrix receipt.
rows.privacy: Platform, package, commit, stage outcome, duration, and normalized error only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; #779 is open and no qualifying matrix receipt exists.
rows.action: Do not infer artifact coverage from source-tree CI.

rows.metric: Escaped defects, discovery, remediation, and rollback
rows.definition: Supported-release defects are classified by severity, surface, discovery source, time to safe state, and rollback or disable action.
rows.denominator: Supported releases and reporting window; rates require an approved denominator.
rows.source: Release notes, advisories, issues, and future release-quality receipts.
rows.privacy: Public issue/advisory metadata and normalized classifications; no private report content.
rows.confidence: Not measured; no normalized retained ledger exists.
rows.action: Define the window and private-to-public aggregation rules before publishing counts.

rows.definition: Per-run fixture timing for command startup, daemon health, listing, tailing, and first output.
rows.denominator: Configured iterations in one benchmark run.
rows.cohort: Disposable COVEN_HOME with the fake Codex fixture on one CI host.
rows.window: One artifact per run; no retained multi-run product window.
rows.privacy: Synthetic fixture, environment redaction, no user repository or provider content.
rows.value: Default input is 3 iterations; report includes per-run min, median, p95, and max.
rows.confidence: Valid deterministic benchmark input; insufficient for field SLOs or p95 claims.
rows.action: Do not gate or publish as an observed product result until sample and regression budgets are approved.

rows.definition: Per-run deterministic load and failure-injection measurements for concurrency, cancellation, storage, backlog, memory, and recovery.
rows.numerator: Recorded durations, rates, sizes, and resource samples by fixture trial.
rows.denominator: Configured 1, 8, and 32-session fixture trials in one run.
rows.cohort: Disposable local fixture environment on one CI host.
rows.window: One report-schema-v3 artifact per run; no retained product window.
rows.source: scripts/benchmark-chaos.mjs and its deterministic acceptance tests.
rows.privacy: Synthetic sessions; resource totals omit process names and command lines.
rows.value: Inputs cover 1, 8, and 32 concurrent sessions plus declared injected recovery trials.
rows.confidence: Valid benchmark condition; not field incidence or an adopted regression budget.
rows.action: Keep deterministic acceptance separate from trend data and observed outcomes.

rows.metric: AgentFS storage and mount boundary certification
rows.definition: Representative platform trials classify storage, path, materialization, concurrency, crash cleanup, credential observation, case handling, handle reuse, access control, and safe disable.
rows.denominator: Required cells for the declared support state.
rows.cohort: Feature-gated AgentFS storage and experimental mount surfaces.
rows.source: AgentFS conformance/mount tests and #779 certification matrix.
rows.privacy: Synthetic paths and payloads; no credentials or repository content.
rows.confidence: Not measured; mount remains experimental and must not inherit generic CI success.
rows.action: Keep mount disabled/experimental until its threat-derived matrix is retained.

rows.definition: Supported client families negotiate versions/capabilities and classify malformed, unsupported, stale-peer, and non-replay outcomes.
rows.numerator: Compatible and explicitly denied cells by client/version/capability.
rows.cohort: Published packages and supported client families.
rows.source: API contract fixtures, coven-client tests, and future #779 receipts.
rows.privacy: Version, capability, route class, and normalized error only.
rows.confidence: Not measured; source compatibility tests are not a published-package matrix.
rows.action: Populate from installed published packages before reporting compatibility coverage.

rows.definition: An opt-in controlled study reaches a named reviewed or accepted outcome and records rework, rollback, elapsed time, repeat use, and a lightweight rating.
rows.numerator: Study tasks reaching the predeclared accepted outcome.
rows.denominator: Opt-in study tasks in the declared cohort.
rows.cohort: Not defined; requires an accountable product decision and consent model.
rows.source: Future opt-in beta or controlled study; never inferred from session completion.
rows.privacy: Aggregate outcome classes and ratings only; no prompts, repository content, credentials, or full output.
rows.confidence: Not measured; no cohort, consent mechanism, or accepted-outcome contract exists.
rows.action: Keep unmeasured until the product owner approves cohort, consent, definition, and breach action.
